Rules.InvariantScript: With({who: Coalesce(LookUp('PDGo Users', Role.Value <> "User" && ServiceSubcategory = DDServiceSubcategory_2.Selected.Value, Email), LookUp('PDGo Users', Role.Value <> "User" && ServiceSubcategory = DDServiceCategory_2.Selected.Value, Email))}, Patch(AdministrativeServiceRequests, RequestSubmissionForm_2.LastSubmit, {AssignedTo: who, Status: {Value: If(IsBlank(who), "Submitted", "Assigned")}})); Notify("Your request has been submitted.", NotificationType.Success); NewForm(RequestSubmissionForm_2)

Switch(
    DDServiceCategory_2.Selected.Value,

    "Facilities",
    Table(
        {Value: "Parking Request"},
        {Value: "Locksmith Request"},
        {Value: "Badge Access"},
        {Value: "Space/Office Request"},
        {Value: "Building Maintenance"},
        {Value: "Filtered Water Requests"}
    ),

    "Procurement",
    Table(
        {Value: "Service and Supplies"},
        {Value: "County Business Cards"},
        {Value: "Amazon Purchases"},
        {Value: "Postage"},
        {Value: "Salvage"}
    ),

    Table({Value: ""})
)

If(
    DDServiceCategory_2.Selected.Value = "Facilities" &&
    DDServiceSubcategory_2.Selected.Value = "Building Maintenance",
    DDRequestType_2.Selected.Value,
    Blank()
)

If(DDParkingLocation_1.Selected.Value = "Civic Center", "Civic Center parking is paid and has a waiting list. Your request will be reviewed.", "Parking at this location is free. No permit purchase needed.")
"The requested file could not be downloaded."

If(
    IsBlank(DDServiceCategory_2.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Service Category.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),
    IsBlank(DDServiceSubcategory_2.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Service Subcategory.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),
    DDServiceCategory_2.Selected.Value = "Facilities" &&
    DDServiceSubcategory_2.Selected.Value = "Building Maintenance" &&
    IsBlank(DDRequestType_2.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Request Type.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),
    SubmitForm(RequestSubmissionForm_2)
)
